card.name: Digits in radioactivity dose conversions
card.fires_on: A digit right after an opening parenthesis or inside a number, where a dose in MBq or kBq is being restated in mCi, or a similar converted measurement follows. Mostly in radiopharmaceutical dosing lines.

modes.label: MBq to mCi conversion
modes.description: The first digit of the millicurie value in brackets after a megabecquerel dose.
modes.example: minimum dose of 37 MBq (<<1>> mCi) as an intravenous bol

modes.label: Digit inside a computed or power value
modes.description: A digit within a number in a calculation or in a power or fiber specification.

card.writes: It seems to suppress unit tokens like mA, kB and dB right after the digit, favoring other continuations.
card.plain: It fires on the number in brackets when a radioactive dose is given a second time in another unit.
